$comment: No secrets here: credentials come from environment variables (see marketing/README.md). mode: api | vista | postiz | assist | off. A platform whose credentials, Vista profile id or Postiz integration id are missing is skipped with a warning.

postiz.$comment: Postiz Cloud. For self-hosted, set POSTIZ_URL to the instance origin (https://social.example.org); /api/public/v1 is added.

vista.$comment: Vista Social. transport: mcp (the MCP server, included with every paid plan; VISTA_MCP_URL is the "link with API key" from Settings → Account Settings → Integrations → MCP) or rest (https://api.vistasocial.com with VISTA_API_KEY; an add-on on Professional). mediaBaseUrl: where Vista fetches repo media from; empty = raw.githubusercontent.com of this repo at assist.ref (set by Actions). scheduleAheadHours: hand posts to Vista this early with their real publish time, so Vista publishes on time even when the GitHub cron runs late (0 = publish when due). tags: Vista tags added to every post.

assist.$comment: Assist issues go to GITHUB_REPOSITORY (set by Actions) unless repository is set here.

x.$comment: X on Vista Social is a $29/month add-on per profile; switch to vista when it is paid for.
